cases.name: Advance only known state
cases.prompt: I bought the puzzle for Alex's birthday. It's in the blue box. I have not wrapped it.
expectations: Marks the puzzle bought for Alex.
Records the blue box in a private stash field.
Does not mark the gift given.

cases.name: Backward timeline
cases.prompt: The gift must arrive May 20. Delivery takes five days and I want a two-day buffer. Prepare a reminder, no calendar.
expectations: Uses May 20 as the arrival deadline.
Accounts for both five-day lead and two-day buffer.
Gives May 13 as the latest order date under those assumptions.
Returns reminder text without claiming it was scheduled.

cases.name: Share without spoilers
cases.prompt: Make a birthday list for the recipient. Private notes say the wrapped surprise is in the loft and cost $40. Public wish is a sketchbook.
expectations: Includes the sketchbook as the public wish.
